description: For one domain or URL, return how often AI answer engines cite it: overall citation rate, the rate on each engine (overall.byEngine: cited runs, that engine's observed runs, and whether the engine's sample clears the evidence floor), confidence tier, rank among all cited domains and within its source role, and per-category segment rates. Use to answer 'does ChatGPT cite <site>' or 'what share of Perplexity runs cite <site>'. A published byEngine row with runsCited 0 means that engine did not cite the domain. byEngine is the whole window, not a rate inside one category.

domain.description: A domain (techcrunch.com) or any URL on it.

description: Ranked sources one answer engine cites, by that engine's citation rate across the whole window; an engine whose collection changed inside the window also returns collectionRegime, its sources since the change, which is what it cites now. Pass category to limit the list to sources with a published segment in that category; the rate stays the whole-window rate and is not a rate inside the category. Collecting categories and engines below the evidence floor withhold the ranking. Use to answer 'what sources does Perplexity cite most?' or 'which sources does Google AI Overviews cite among published <category> sources'.

category.description: Optional category key. Limits the ranking to sources with a published segment in that category.
